title: Manischewitz Potato Knishes (Frozen)
instructions: Place the frozen knish on a baking sheet.
Bake 20-25 minutes, until the crust is golden and the filling is heated through.
Rest a few minutes before eating.
notes: Store-bought frozen staple. 1 serving = 1 knish. This is Manischewitz's frozen line: gluten-free, Kosher for Passover, 19 oz package of 6 knishes. The package's printed heating directions could not be found online, so the directions here are standard bake-from-frozen. Confirm exact directions from the package; Yidi will send a package photo from home.
